shots.title: Accept decimal sprint ids in retro post-merge and durable retro memory (#529)
shots.notes: Replaced the post-merge retro sprint parser with the shared decimal sprint parser, relaxed the core retro sprint assertion to allow finite positive decimal ids, and added CLI/core regressions for S146.1-style post-merge retros.

shots.title: Bump package and bundled plugin manifest to 1.58.2 for the retro fix
shots.notes: Ran scripts/version-bump.mjs 1.58.2 and verified the built CLI reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.2 before preparing the follow-up release.

conditions.description: S146.2 was inserted after the v1.58.1 release because the post-merge retro/memory gate itself exposed the decimal sprint gap.

training.description: Every post-hole and post-merge routine must share the same sprint-id parsing model as roadmap and scorecards.
training.outcome: `slope retro post-merge --sprint=146.1` now preserves decimal sprint ids in output paths, records, and durable memory text.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/commands/retro.test.ts tests/core/retro.test.ts` passed: 12 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck` and `corepack pnpm build` passed.
`node dist/cli/index.js retro post-merge --sprint=146.1 ... --dry-run --json` passed, and `node dist/cli/index.js version` reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.2.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A tidy repair on the exact edge that release discipline touched: small code change, high trust value.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding decimal sprint support, grep for integer-only parser helpers in the adjacent lifecycle command, not just the main roadmap command.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The retro core builder also enforced integer sprints, so the CLI parser fix alone would not have been enough.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The S146.1 post-merge retro can now be captured with the real sprint id before S147 starts.

bunker_locations: Post-merge retro sprint parsing must stay aligned with roadmap, scorecard, validation, and branch-inference decimal sprint support.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/commands/retro.ts now uses parseSprintNumber for post-merge --sprint.
src/core/retro.ts now accepts finite positive decimal sprint ids.
tests/cli/commands/retro.test.ts and tests/core/retro.test.ts cover decimal post-merge retro memory behavior.
course_management_notes: Created GitHub issue #529 for the decimal post-merge retro failure.
The PR should include `Closes #529`; after merge, create GitHub Release `v1.58.2` and verify npm latest updates.
